name: Yellow-throated Hanging-Parrot
rangeDescription: Java and bali
description: Tiny short-tailed parrot, endemic to Java and Bali. Leaf-green overall, with a bright red rump, pale eyes, and dainty orange bill.

name: Fish Crow
rangeDescription: Eastern usa (new england to eastern texas)
description: A relatively small, glossy crow. Very difficult to separate from American Crow by appearance; look for Fish Crow’s slightly more tapered wings, quicker wingbeats, and shorter legs.

name: Plain-pouched Hornbill
rangeDescription: Southern myanmar, southwestern and southern thailand, and northern thai-malay peninsula
description: Medium-sized hornbill; resembles a smaller version of Wreathed Hornbill. Black with a white tail.

name: Red-flanked Bluetail
rangeDescription: Breeds from finland and northern russia eastward to mongolia, northeastern china, korea, and japan; resident in japan (except for hokkaido), otherwise winters to southern china, taiwan, indochina, myanmar, and thailand
description: Beautiful adult male is shimmering sky-blue above and pale below, with orange sides and a small white eyebrow. Female and juvenile are more subdued, but still have the rufous flanks and blue tail.

name: Costa Rican Brushfinch
rangeDescription: Highlands of southwestern costa rica and western panama (chiriquí)
description: Medium-sized sparrowlike bird with green back, gray eyebrow, black cheek, and white throat. Most similar to Black-striped Sparrow but with entire cheek black (not just eyeline); also compare with Chestnut-capped Brushfinch but note lack of rufous crown.

name: Ashy Minivet
rangeDescription: Northeastern asia; winters to philippines and indonesia
description: Slender, long-tailed gray songbird, usually seen in small to medium-sized flocks. Male has a distinct black-and-white head pattern, of which the female has a paler gray version.

name: Heuglin's Spurfowl
rangeDescription: Central african republic to southern sudan, northern democratic republic of the congo, and western uganda
description: Large and brownish francolin with yellow-orange legs, bill, and bare skin around the eyes. Also note the heavily striped and spotted neck and underparts and the strong facial pattern.

name: Sula Lorikeet
rangeDescription: Sula islands (taliabu, seho, and mangole)
description: Vibrantly beautiful small lorikeet with a bright red bill and extensive golden-yellow “scaling” on the breast. Leaf-green back separated sharply from yellow head by a vertical dark bar.

name: Seram Bush Warbler
rangeDescription: Seram island (southern moluccas)
description: A sparrow-sized dark warbler with an often scruffy-looking, graduated tail. Has dark chestnut-brown upperparts, a whitish eyebrow, a distinct white throat, and dull grayish underparts.

name: Hudsonian Godwit
rangeDescription: Breeds locally in alaska and northern canada (east to hudson bay); winters in southern south america (argentina and south-central chile), southward to tierra del fuego
description: The smallest godwit, overall rather dark. Long upturned bill, red at the base with a black tip.

name: Montagu's Harrier
rangeDescription: Northern palearctic; winters to southern africa, iran, and india
description: Lightly built hawk with rather narrow and somewhat tapered wings. Favors heathland, grassland, arable fields, marshes.

name: Yellow-lored Bristlebill
rangeDescription: Southeastern nigeria to central african republic; bioko
description: An unusual and colorful rainforest bulbul. The upperparts are dark olive-green and the underparts yellow.

name: Rufous-chested Dotterel
rangeDescription: Breeds southern chile (north to chiloé) and southern argentina to tierra del fuego and falkland islands; winters north to northern chile and southeastern brazil
description: A handsome, distinctive, and medium-sized plover that breeds on southern moorland and steppe, and migrates north to winter on beaches and coastal flats. Found mainly in pairs and small loose groups in summer, but migrant and winter flocks can be a few hundred birds.

name: Red-breasted Nuthatch
rangeDescription: Coniferous forest of north america
description: Small, cute, energetic nuthatch. Distinctive with bold black-and-white head pattern, blue-gray upperparts, and orangey belly.

name: Turquoise-throated Barbet
rangeDescription: Mountains of eastern peninsular thailand
description: Restricted to montane forest in a tiny corner of southern Peninsular Thailand, this brightly-colored tree-dweller is nonetheless not uncommon within its limited range and habitat. Very similar in appearance to Blue-throated Barbet, but ranges do not overlap; also note present species’ thick black line behind the eye, and its paler throat.

name: Yap Monarch
rangeDescription: Forest of yap (northwestern caroline islands)
description: Unique black-and-white monarch endemic to Yap, in Micronesia, where it inhabits various forested lowland habitats, including mangroves and coastal scrub. Male has a white body and black head, wings, and tail.

name: White-winged Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Aral sea to lake balkhash, northeastern afghanistan, and far western china
description: Large black-and-white woodpecker; very similar to Great Spotted Woodpecker, but with a single large and rather formless white patch dominating the entire wing instead of scattered white dots and bars. Found in waterside clusters of forest, preferring poplar stands, in the largely dry and treeless expanses of Central Asia.

name: Wandering Tattler
rangeDescription: Siberia and alaska; winters to northern south america, hawaii, and southwestern oceania
description: Medium-sized, gray shorebird with short yellow legs and straight bill. Elongated, horizontal posture.

name: Rufous-vented Whitetip
rangeDescription: East slope of andes in southern colombia and eastern ecuador
description: Rare hummingbird of cloud forest on the east slope of the Andes. Male is mostly green with darker throat and white tips to the inner tail feathers that combine to form a round spot.

name: Gray-crowned Tetraka
rangeDescription: Rainforest of eastern madagascar
description: Attractive, medium-sized tetraka. Green back, gray head, white throat, and yellowish underparts.
